description: This file defines the 'Interest' class within the PHPSpreadsheet project, providing financial functions such as IPMT, ISPMT, and RATE, for calculating interest payments, interest payments schedule, and interest rate in financial calculations.

classes.name: Interest
classes.description: Provides financial calculation methods such as interest payments (IPMT), interest schedule (ISPMT), and interest rate determinations (RATE).

methods.name: payment
methods.description: Calculates the interest payment for a given period based on investment parameters, returning a float or error message.

methods.name: schedulePayment
methods.description: Calculates the interest payment for a specific period of a payment schedule, considering remaining principal.

methods.name: rate
methods.description: Estimates the interest rate per period of an annuity through an iterative process, returning a float or an error.
